escape_bytes_for_protobuf: escape a bytes string with C-style escapes for use in a text protocol buffer
unescape_protobuf_text: unescape a text string with C-style escape sequences back to UTF-8 bytes
escape_unicode_text: escape unicode text preserving non-ASCII characters for protocol buffer serialization
escape_byte_string: escape a byte string using octal escapes for non-printable and high-byte characters
review_CEscape_CUnescape: review the CEscape and CUnescape functions for handling C-style escape sequences in protobuf text encoding
